description: A self-referential many relation uses its named join table

statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `friendship` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `person_id` blob NOT NULL,
  `related_person_id` blob NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `friendship_person_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`person_id`) REFERENCES `person`(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `friendship_related_person_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`related_person_id`) REFERENCES `person`(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `friendship_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `friendship_person_id_related_person_id_unique` UNIQUE(`person_id`, `related_person_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `friendship_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `friendship_person_id_index` ON `friendship` (`person_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `friendship_related_person_id_index` ON `friendship` (`related_person_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `friendship_owner_index` ON `friendship` (`owner`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `person` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `name` text,
  CONSTRAINT `person_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `person_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `person_owner_index` ON `person` (`owner`)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `friendship_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `friendship`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `friendship`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `person_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `person`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `person`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE VIEW `friendship_view` AS
SELECT
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`person_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`person_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`person_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`person_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`person_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`person_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `person_id`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`related_person_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`related_person_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`related_person_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`related_person_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`related_person_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`related_person_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `related_person_id`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'name', `r`.`name`) FROM `person` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`id` = `t`.`person_id` LIMIT 1) AS `person`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'name', `r`.`name`) FROM `person` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`id` = `t`.`related_person_id` LIMIT 1) AS `related_person`
FROM `friendship` AS `t`

CREATE VIEW `person_view` AS
SELECT
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`name` AS `name`,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_group_array(json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'name', `r`.`name`)), json('[]')) FROM `person` AS `r` JOIN `friendship` AS `j` ON `j`.`related_person_id` = `r`.`id` WHERE `j`.`person_id` = `t`.`id` ORDER BY `r`.`id`) AS `friends`
FROM `person` AS `t`
